summary: The note, dated October 5, 2023, presents ten categories of automation and AI tools that small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) can use to streamline operations, from chatbots and marketing automation to cybersecurity and business process management. Each category names example products, and several include quotes from business users reporting gains in customer satisfaction, productivity and conversion rates. It concludes that these tools set a new benchmark for efficiency and position SMEs for growth and competitiveness.
one_line: A list of ten automation and AI tool categories, with example products and user testimonials, that help SMEs improve efficiency and competitiveness.
key_facts: The note is dated October 5, 2023 and covers the top 10 automation tools accessible to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs).
Chatbots such as Intercom and Drift let businesses engage with customers 24/7 and reduce customer support costs.
Jane McAllister, CEO of an e-commerce platform, said customer satisfaction soared after she implemented a chatbot service in early September 2023.

Marketing automation tools HubSpot and Marketo automate email campaigns, social media posting and lead generation; digital marketing specialist David Chen reports boosted ROI for his clients since late 2023.
Google Analytics and Tableau use AI to give SMEs data insights once reachable only by larger corporations.
QuickBooks and Xero automate invoicing, payroll and other financial tasks; entrepreneur Lisa Reynolds said the time saved is now used to develop new services for clients.
TradeGecko and Zoho Inventory automate inventory, supply chain and order fulfillment, helping forecast demand and prevent stockouts or overstock.
BambooHR and Gusto automate payroll, benefits administration and recruitment filtering for HR.
Project manager Roberto Garcia reported a 30 percent uptick in project turnaround time after implementing Asana in the last quarter of 2023.
Jenny Hu, a sales director, said conversion rates improved by 25% after using Pipedrive's automation for follow-ups.
Darktrace and CrowdStrike offer AI-powered real-time threat detection and response that were once too costly for SME budgets.
Monday.com and Kissflow are BPM tools offering workflow design, execution, monitoring and optimization.
